_approach: Breakstep / two-step-with-a-break hybrid (Deekline 'I Don't Smoke', DJ Zinc '138 Trek'): trades 2-step's rolling MPC shuffle for a straighter, breakbeat-derived kick/snare skeleton at garage tempo — kick lands on beat 1 and the classic amen '&-of-3' pickup, the clap still anchors 2 and 4 as the one fixed point, and chopped ghost-snare/rim hits stand in for the amen's ratatat fills instead of skippy hat decoration. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
